note: [LLM critic, medium conf] The AI sent a lone 3-model unit on a 3-turn trip into the enemy zone to flip obj_nml_2. That objective has 9 to 11 enemy OC, so the unit cannot take it alone and risks being killed. Fix: Do not send a unit to an objective it cannot flip alone when the enemy OC there is at least 2 times the unit's OC and the trip takes 2 or more turns. Cut expected_vp by the odds of winning the contest. Keep the unit with the main army on a held or contested central objective, and treat surplus OC there as support and screening, not as a reason to leave.
